name: Del Taco
src: Del Taco Menu Items Nutritional List and Allergen List (September 2026). Allergens and Vegetarian/Vegan are the Allergen List's marks, matched to each item by name. Left out: meals (calorie ranges only), the chicken & fries box and bottled water; 3 item(s) not on the Allergen List have no allergens (Flamin' Hot Queso Loaded Fries (Carne Asada Steak), Minute Maid Zero Sugar Lemonade Dirty Del (large), Minute Maid Zero Sugar Lemonade Dirty Del (regular)).
